input.question: Is there an endpoint to delete an agent created with the Agents API?

content.content:
{"result":"Yes, there is an endpoint to delete an agent created with the Agents API. The endpoint is:

```
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}
```

This endpoint requires the `agent_id` parameter, which is the unique identifier of the agent you want to delete [1].

Additionally, you can delete an agent version alias using the following endpoint:

```
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/aliases
```

This endpoint deletes an existing alias for an agent [2].

For a more detailed guide on how to delete an agent, refer to the documentation which states that you can open the three-dots menu (`⠇`) on the Agent card and select `Delete` to confirm the deletion [4].

content.text:
Yes — the Agents API supports agent deletion:

```
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}
```

Just pass the `agent_id` of the agent you want to remove. There's also a related endpoint for deleting a specific agent version alias:

```
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/aliases
```

Docs: [Beta Agents API reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/beta/agents#operation-agents_api_v1_agents_delete)
